mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer demand, measured by HOUST, leads to higher corporate earnings expectations and thus a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: Significant negative 20-day forward returns when HOUST growth exceeds +10% in two consecutive months, with no change in other macro variables.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in employment, as reflected in PAYEMS, reduces labor market uncertainty and boosts investor confidence, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Negative 60-day returns when PAYEMS growth exceeds +5% month-over-month for three consecutive months without other supportive macro signals.

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation rate crosses above 2%, the S&P 500 anticipates a Fed rate hike path, producing a negative 20-day forward return.
failure_condition: Positive 20-day returns when CPIAUCSL crosses above 2% but FEDFUNDS remains unchanged for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening demand or supply chain issues, which typically precede a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: No significant negative 5-day returns when INDPRO declines by > -2% in two consecutive months with other demand proxies stable.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in both HOUST (consumer) and RSAFS (retail) suggest dual demand channels, generating a positive 20-day forward return when both rise above their prior month's levels.
failure_condition: No forward return when either HOUST or RSAFS rises alone, or their joint effect passes a Granger causality test p > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 4% triggers a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return under a strong labor market regime.
failure_condition: No return when UNRATE falls below 4% but corporate earnings momentum is missing (negative 20-day IC).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains above 4% for three consecutive months, the S&P 500 expects higher rates and thus a negative 20-day forward return.
failure_condition: Positive returns when FEDFUNDS > 4% but subsequent months show rate cuts.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in INDPRO for two months in a row, without recovery in other supply indicators, predicts a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return due to supply-side weakness.
failure_condition: No negative return when INDPRO declines but then rebounds sharply in the following month.
